sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:19

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:19:1
items.html: The Ruach that he casts into her, and it, too, is from the Hesed, in the secret of Eloha, except that it is from the RIU: You already know that at the first intercourse — that is, at the time that ZA bestows the Mochin of Gadlut upon the Nukva — he gives her then, together with the vessel that raises the MAN, also the discernment of the first Ruach, called the Ruach that her husband casts into her, as above. For Bina and ZON of the vessels, which ascend from BYA and connect with the Nukva, are called the vessel that raises the MAN, which is the discernment of the posterior of the name BON, which is RIU in Gematria. And the discernments of the lights within Bina and ZON, which clothe in that vessel, are SAG, MA and BON, from the discernment of the HaVaYaH of AB, which is RIU in Gematria; and these three ABs are the discernments of the Ruach that he casts into her, as above. Therefore, on the one hand they are reckoned as Hesed, since they come from the expansion of the Mochin from the illumination of AB; and on the other hand they are reckoned as Gevurot, since they are only lights of Bina and ZON, which are posterior and Gevura. Therefore they are called RIU, which is Gevura in Gematria, as is known. And this is what he says: the clothing of the soul, which comes from that Ruach that her husband casts into her, is from the Hesed in the secret of Eloha, and it is from Gevura, because it is from the RIU — for the lights are the expansion of the Mochin of Gadlut, which are Hassadim and males; however, since they are attributed and spread in the posterior vessels, Bina and ZON, they are therefore discerned as Gevurot, but the discernment of the Gevurot within the Hassadim.
